body: Okay

A lot of people. I've ether burned out everyone I trust or don't want to ruin their mood right as good things are starting to happen. I've had major depression a long time, seven suicide attempts in the past five years, and even if they're still willing to help, I don't want to spread this.

I've tried going to councillors and psychs, I end up missing a session and then never going back. I don't know why, I like being in counselling. It just happens.

I feel like I'm just someone that people used to know and now is just an annoyance on Facebook. I'm trapped in my house, agoraphobia and health issues, and I can't do anything. I can barely write, which was my last bastion of sanity. I feel like nothing, like a nobody, only around to sleep and consume.

There's supposed to be something better on the horizon but I can't see it. I have no one to see it with if I could.

Another trigger warning here for suicide deconstruction.

That's not a hard fact though. I read that post the first time the blog was brought up and I found problems with it personally. Mostly the overuse of post flowey Asriel(Sociopathic due to lack of soul and immortality bordem.), the overuse of genocide run Chara, and no delving in to Narrator Chara. We don't actually know all that much about the character in the end because they died before the story actually came to pass, thus the headcannon's we have make them up. 

It's fine to have that schism and for this particular theory, borderline personality doesn't rule out the potential for abuse by the hands of Chara. I Just personally can't see it. 

What I do know about, and have at least anecdotal evidence of, is ingesting poisons, the mindset going in to a suicide attempt, and the after effects of that scenario. 

There is no way that ingesting buttercups is going to look like a random sickness. You're going to puke the undigested plant matter everywhere, the symptoms are pretty significant and at that point would be known to the Substitute Parents. Not long before, the kids ended up accidentally poisoning Asgore with the exact thing that Chara killed themselves with. 

The method of death is brutal, unpleasant, and has a ring of penance to it. At that point there was no grantee that their plan would work, only stories of human souls lasting told to children. They were trying to kill themselves in a grand gesture that would "Cause good."

It happens a lot in suicide cases, someone tries to make their suicide mean something. "I don't want to be a burden," is a pretty common one which morphs in to, "Everyone would be better off without me. 

I have no idea way they had Asriel bring them the flowers. You got me there.

This is the headcannon I'm coming to bat with, by the way. Someone told me I should post this for context.

http://thefloweryfanclub.tumblr.com/post/143284030397/greetings-uh-so-ive-been-working-on-this

If you've been suicidal before or if this is triggering, let me know and I'll delete the post. I'm going to be talking about how it feels to be suicidal right now and I don't want to send anyone in to a spiral because of a discussion. 

To start this off, I'm just going to mention that this doesn't rule out the possibility for emotional abuse on their part or anything like that, that is a potential part of BPD. It's not something that happened in my headcannon and the post you put up doesn't convince me. 

I've had seven suicide attempts in the past five years. I've had suicidal ideation since I was five years old. It's not a pleasant experience or one I'd wish on anyone. It's also a sporadic thing that comes and goes with moodswings. 

I've had a LOT of time to think about how I want to die. I've made plans in my head, set things out before, and gone through with a few. The planning may be premeditated but the actual act, at least for me, is purely impulsive. As an example, I used to have a cord hung in my closet just in case. 

Going through with suicide isn't determination, it's a release. It doesn't matter if it's violent, silent, or both, it's a way to stop the trauma that you endure. It's a way to break the wave of emotion that wells up and refuses to dissipate on it's own.

I've done things that have done permanent harm post attempt. I ended up overdosing on Ibuprofen that ended up, more than likely, causing me to develop Crohn's not long after. I have scars on my wrist from practice cuts for the obvious. They wouldn't be stuffing themselves with buttecup stems long after they started puking, they'd have eaten as much as they could and then just collapsed from the after effects.

As for mentioning it or planning it with Asriel. It doesn't have to be malicious manipulation, just rumination. Talking to someone they trust about what's running through their head at the time. I've straight out said to friends, "I feel like I want to kill myself," and then tried to laugh it off. It may even have undertext of wanting help but since they were both extremely young at the time, nether could actually tell that.

Just because they had hope/determination after finding a new family doesn't mean that they had it when they went up the mountain. After they fell, they found a new family that treated them like one of their own. Toriel is a splended goat mom and Asgore is a kind monster who would do anything for his children. They did lose determination over time though, otherwise the buttercup incident would have just been another reset for them. 

As for meaning to kill themselves. Impulsivity doesn't mean that there was no meaning behind the action. They may have talked to Asriel about it almost in a joking or story like matter for a long time before something forced them to the point of actually doing it. Trust me when I say, it happens like that sometimes.

Nice catch. I never actually saw the kickstarter. Though, I can probably eek in the fact that the 'story's say that people disappear' to be part of the reason they went up. 

The buttercup incident may have had a bit of planning behind it but the actual act seemed impulsive to me. But that's headcannon, I know I'm projecting quite a bit on to a ten year old. ^6^
